name: devenv
description: Set up a machine and its toolchain once: migrate a legacy Python venv project to mise + uv, manage dotfiles config files as symlinks, and delegate SSH keys to hosts through an audited manifest.

interface.shortDescription: One-time machine and toolchain environment setup
interface.longDescription: Devenv bundles the three skills used to set a machine up once and leave it reproducible: mise-migrate converts a legacy Python venv/pip project into the canonical mise + uv structure, symlink-manager moves a config file into the dotfiles repo and links it back with a backup, and ssh-delegate replaces ad-hoc ssh-copy-id with a manifest-backed, fingerprint-pinned, audit-logged delegation workflow. All three write, and each stops for confirmation before it does.
defaultPrompt: Migrate this venv project to mise + uv.
Manage this config file with a symlink.
